name: eggd_swap-prep-dna-vcf
title: RNA-swap identity QC: prepare DNA germline site list
summary: Select germline heterozygous SNVs from a TSO500 DNA VCF, lift over to GRCh38 only if needed, and restrict to the PanCan capture region.

inputSpec.name: dna_vcf
inputSpec.label: TSO500 DNA genome VCF
inputSpec.help: Raw *_MergedSmallVariants.genome.vcf (or equivalent) — the full PASS/non-PASS call set, not a curated hotspot/annotated subset. Its own header is inspected to determine genome build; no build is assumed from the filename.

inputSpec.name: reference_fasta
inputSpec.label: GRCh38 reference FASTA
inputSpec.help: The exact GRCh38 reference used by the matched RNA aligner (e.g. the CTAT reference used by STAR/Eunomia). Used both as the LiftoverVcf target and, when the DNA VCF is already GRCh38, as the contig-length cross-check.

inputSpec.name: chain_file
inputSpec.label: hg19->GRCh38 liftover chain
inputSpec.help: Only used when dna_vcf is detected as hg19/GRCh37. Still required as an input even for a GRCh38 dna_vcf, since build is not known until the app inspects the VCF header at runtime.

inputSpec.name: capture_bed
inputSpec.label: GRCh38 RNA capture-region BED
inputSpec.help: PanCan/TSFP capture manifest already mapped to GRCh38 — no liftover needed on this side.

inputSpec.name: gatk_jar
inputSpec.label: GATK jar (LiftoverVcf)
inputSpec.help: Provided directly as a file input rather than resolved through an asset-selection manifest, to keep this app free of any manifest/candidate/validation-mode indirection. The caller is responsible for supplying the correct, fixed GATK build every time.

inputSpec.name: sample_id
inputSpec.label: Sample/specimen identifier (label only)
inputSpec.help: Used only to label prepare_qc_json for human readability. Never used for pairing/discovery logic — this app compares nothing and looks up nothing.

outputSpec.name: rejected_liftover_vcf
outputSpec.label: LiftoverVcf REJECT output
outputSpec.help: Header-only (no records) when liftover was skipped because dna_vcf was already GRCh38 — the output contract is always satisfied so downstream tooling never has to special-case a missing file.

outputSpec.name: prepare_qc_json
outputSpec.label: Preparation funnel/QC report
outputSpec.help: Detected input genome build and the evidence used to determine it, whether liftover ran, and site counts retained/rejected at each pipeline step.
